title: HeyHi Prototype Audit Baseline Sidecar
description: Structured sidecar that accompanies the markdown narrative for one prototype audit cycle. Carries gap IDs, severities, classifications, and phase assignments in a flat schema for trivial month-over-month diffing. Source: plans/track-b-prototype-audit-buildable-2026-05-06.md §3.5.

schema_version.description: Schema version for forward compatibility. Adding fields is non-breaking; renaming or removing fields is breaking.

prototype_path.description: Absolute or workspace-relative path to the prototype source file at audit time.

prototype_purpose.description: What the prototype is trying to demonstrate. Drawn from Step 1 of the audit.

scope_count.description: Total interaction points enumerated in Step 2 planning pass — navigable states x directions x row types x action triggers.

readiness_threshold.description: The audit's assessment of where the prototype currently sits. 'none' means none of the three thresholds are met; the prototype is below stakeholder-ready.

phases.description: Gap IDs assigned to each build phase from Step 4. A gap appears in exactly one phase.

foundation.description: Cross-cutting Critical items — shared architecture, delegated handlers, global state.

critical.description: Direction-specific or component-specific Critical items — core workflow demonstration.

high.description: High severity items of any classification — feedback states, selection indicators, auto-checks.

polish.description: Medium severity items — animation, edge cases, empty states.

gaps.description: All gaps documented in Step 3 audit pass. Each gap appears exactly once and is also referenced by ID in exactly one phase array under 'phases'.

gap_id.description: Stable identifier across audit cycles. Convention: [classification-prefix]-[number], e.g., 'CX-1' for cross-cutting #1, 'COMP-3' for component-specific #3.

severity.description: Severity tier. Critical = workflow cannot be demonstrated. High = mechanical step works but no feedback. Medium = visible only under scrutiny.

classification.description: Cross-cutting = same gap across components/directions. Direction-specific = affects one direction or flow. Component-specific = isolated to one component.

current_state.description: What exists in the prototype today, written specifically against the source.

required_state.description: What the prototype should do, written from the user/reviewer perspective.

implementation_notes.description: Concrete code or pseudocode. Must be verified in Step 5 pre-flight against actual selectors, identifiers, and DOM paths.

phase.description: Build phase assignment. Cross-cutting Critical -> foundation; direction/component Critical -> critical; High (any) -> high; Medium -> polish.

layer_2_source.description: Optional. Set when this gap was surfaced by a Layer 2 check rather than the Layer 1 audit pass. Omit for Layer 1 findings.

layer_2_status.description: Records whether Layer 2 ran and which checks were executed or skipped.

ran.description: True when Layer 2 was activated and at least one check executed. False when Layer 2 was skipped entirely (no config, validation failure, completeness < 30).

config_path.description: Path to the brand config used by Layer 2. Null when Layer 2 did not run.

config_capability_tier.description: Capability tier returned by ui-studio validate.py --status. Null when validation did not run or returned no tier.

checks_run.description: Checks that executed. Empty array when ran=false.

reason.description: Why this check was skipped — e.g., 'config below PARTIAL_A; layout pattern check requires fidelity >= 60'.

layer_3_metadata.description: Care retainer cycle metadata. Populated when running as Layer 3; carries client and cycle context.

client.description: Client name (slug) for the engagement. Null for one-off audits not run under a Care retainer.

cycle.description: Cycle period in YYYY-MM format. Null for one-off audits.

tier.description: Engagement tier. care+ = recurring monthly delta cadence; standalone = one-off audit run outside the Care retainer.

previous_baseline_path.description: Path to the previous month's sidecar JSON used for delta computation. Null when this is the first cycle (no prior baseline).
